Subject: Principles of Programming Languages
Time: 3 Hours Max.Marks: 75
Note: Answer all questions from Part A. Answer any five questions from Part B.

PART — A (25 Marks)
in what fundamental way do operational semantics and denotational semantics differ?
Which performs faster program execution, a compiler or an interpreter?
Define lifetime, scope, static scope and dynamic scope.
What are advantages of named constants?
Write the general form (syntax) of for statement of Ada and Python languages.
What is naming encapsulation?
What is the difference between physical and logical concurrency?
What advantages do monitors have over semaphores?
Describe the syntax and semantics of COND and LET?
Write the syntax for instantiating an object in Python for a class named Myclass.
